ZEC.summary: NU7 still targets block 3,543,405 (about Nov 5): 25-second blocks, unchanged issuance and 60% of fees set aside. Founders are debating ending the dev fund early, and the Grayscale ETF had a small $4.6M outflow on Oct 30. No vesting unlocks (PoW issuance only).

news.title: NU7 nears mainnet at block 3,543,405 (around Nov 5); Sprout-pool funds may become unspendable, ZEC near $1,360
Two proposals to end Zcash's $300M+ dev fund early (fully or just the 8% ZCG share); Grayscale ZCSH saw a $4.6M outflow Oct 30
Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) takes in $20.5M on Oct 23, the largest altcoin-ETF inflow that day

MORPHO.summary: Fundamentals still support the long: RWA deposits above $2B and fee growth. After the Oct 29 Binance hack, lenders pulled liquidity and some Morpho borrow rates briefly hit ~40% before easing to 9-13%; MORPHO bounced ~15% on Oct 31. No unlocks in the next 14 days.

news.title: Lenders pull liquidity after the Binance hack; Morpho borrow rates spike to ~40% and squeeze leveraged Pendle PT trades, then ease to 9-13%
Morpho's real-world-asset markets pass $2B in deposits with about $894M in loans outstanding
1kx report: onchain lending fees fell ~50% year over year while Morpho's Q3 fees edged up to ~$62M

DOT.summary: DOT stays below $1 after the dotUSD XCM accounting bug (fix referendum 1961 in voting); CoinShares' Polkadot staking ETP is still set for redemption around Nov 9. No vesting unlocks.

news.title: XCM bug undercounted dotUSD supply; arbitrage cost the Treasury about $1.3M while a fix referendum is voted
DOT slips to about $0.98, roughly 98% below its 2021 peak, despite the supply cap and dotUSD launch

LIT.summary: Mixed for the long: fee-funded LIT buybacks continue, but Robinhood is routing US perps through its own Bitstamp rather than Lighter until CFTC rules allow onchain perps. No unlocks until late January 2027.

news.title: Robinhood picks Bitstamp over Lighter for US perps; Lighter says onchain perps will follow once the CFTC allows them

AVNT.summary: A monthly unlock of about 24.7M AVNT (2.5% of total supply, roughly 9% of circulating) is listed for Nov 9, split across community, private investors and insiders, plus small daily emissions. That adds supply and helps the short. No other material news; the Veranta rebrand changes only the name.

news.title: Avantis rebrands to Veranta; INDODAX updates the display name, AVNT ticker and contract unchanged

unlocks.note: Monthly unlock, 2.5% of total supply: community 43%, private investors 36%, insiders 18%, foundation 3%

ANIME.summary: No material Animecoin news this week. No dated unlock in the next 14 days; the previously noted Nov 23 release (about 130M ANIME, ~1.3% of supply) falls outside the window.

kBONK.summary: No price-moving BONK news this week; the long-promised burn milestone has no confirmed date. Fully unlocked, so no unlock supply.

WCT.summary: Nothing material this week. Monthly unlocks fall on the 15th; the next (Nov 15) is outside the 14-day window.

BERA.summary: No price-moving BERA news found in the last week. Neither Tokenomist nor DropsTab lists a dated unlock in the next 14 days; only small ongoing linear vesting and validator emissions, which add a little supply.

REZ.summary: No material Renzo news in the last week; buybacks remain paused and over 95% of supply is already circulating. The next insider release (80M REZ) is listed for Nov 28, outside the 14-day window.

MERL.summary: No price-moving Merlin Chain news in the last 7 days. Tokenomics.com lists a ~38.6M MERL release (foundation, investors, community, insiders) on Nov 1, but other trackers disagree or don't show it, so the date is unconfirmed and not listed here.

SKY.summary: No new Sky news this week; the Q3 report (rising revenue, monthly SKY buybacks and burns) is still the latest. SKY is essentially fully unlocked, so no unlocks in the next 14 days.

news.title: Sky Q3 report: net revenue $37.2M (sixth straight positive quarter), $5.6M of buybacks for 87.5M SKY, 7.37M SKY burned Oct 12

HYPER.summary: No HYPER-specific news in the last 7 days; moves (down 9% Oct 30, up 13% Oct 31) tracked the wider market. No unlocks in the next 14 days; the next listed tranche is ~22.3M HYPER (2.2% of total supply, mostly insiders and investors) on Nov 22, just outside the window.
